entities.name: Icehaven
entities.description: The northernmost island of the Domains, largest after Aerona, notorious for its cold climate and home to small states and stone giant tribes.

entities.name: Domains
entities.description: The island group Icehaven belongs to.

entities.name: Aerona
entities.description: Continent separated from Icehaven by the Rip.

entities.name: Keld
entities.description: A nation of large, gray-skinned warriors taking up most of Icehaven.

entities.name: Parma
entities.description: Theocratic kingdom of the Northern Paladins on the east tip of Icehaven.

entities.name: Stone giants
entities.description: Indigenous tribes separating Icehaven's small states.

entities.name: Agderisk
entities.description: A port city on the southern coast.

entities.name: Keldon Twilight
entities.description: Event during which the Keldon Necropolis was destroyed.

entities.name: Letha
entities.description: An outcast village destroyed by the dragon Skouras.

entities.name: The Mountain
entities.description: A lone volcano and sacred peak.

entities.name: Kvardalen
entities.description: A centaur village in the Gurdurngs.

entities.name: Rathi Overlay
entities.description: Event after which Rootwater and the Skyshroud Forest were placed on Icehaven.

events.summary: The Keldon Necropolis is destroyed during the Keldon Twilight.
events.quote: The Keldon Necropolis - destroyed during the Keldon Twilight .

events.summary: The dragon Skouras destroys the outcast village of Letha.
events.quote: Letha - an outcast village, destroyed by the dragon Skouras .
